research_rationale:
Identity and text: the held original is the Federal Register text (73 FR 9437, Federal Register of February 20, 2008, 2 PDF pages) of Executive Order 13461 of February 15, 2008, Providing an Order of Succession Within the Department of Health and Human Services. I read the held text in full; its title, number, date and FR pages agree with the register row. The clause inventory has 18 clauses and matches the text. The order is not emergency-based: it rests on the Federal Vacancies Reform Act of 1998, 5 U.S.C. 3345 et seq. Status YES is retained on the established original_plus_bounded_search route: the held original, no own-terms end (the text contains no sunset or expiry), no held later instrument (a search of the held executive-order texts for the order's number and for later orders of succession within the Department of Health and Human Services found none), and the three bounded searches. The machine U.S. Code search records one hit (the 5 U.S.C. 3345 note for the Department of Health and Human Services, which lists this order), but no legal-text slice of that note is held as selectable evidence in the packet, so I do not rely on it as a held predicate; the eCFR and OFR catalog searches record no hit. The predicate therefore rests on the held original, the absence of any held ending or amending instrument, and the bounded searches, as in the established route. Because no clause-specific current-law text is held, this is the weakest form of the route; the claim discloses that. Searches selected after reading their coverage notes in the packet: current-law:usc (U.S. Code release point 119-121, statute text and editorial notes, edition current through 2026-10-09, so laws enacted from 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-14 are not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR point-in-time search as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML, 49 titles read) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Federal Register executive-order catalog disposition notes, 6942 catalog records, plus operative sentences in 16784 saved order texts). Each is marked complete with no coverage warning; they are machine leads, and I read the held later texts myself. Every clause is decided as of 2026-10-14.
